custom_logic_notes: Multicurrency panel trading 3 symbols simultaneously (EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD). AutoTrader mode: on every tick, if buy signal > sell signal and no position exists, opens BUY; if position exists but is opposite direction, closes and reverses. Signal is computed from comparing current bar[0] vs previous bar[1] across 7 price-derived metrics (Open, High, Low, (H+L)/2, Close, (H+L+C)/3, (H+L+C+C)/4), counting how many are bullish vs bearish. Manual BUY/SELL via panel buttons at Ask/Bid respectively. No SL/TP set on any trade. Position reversal closes existing then opens opposite on same tick.
python_conversion_notes: Signal logic is straightforward (bar comparison, no indicator handles needed). Main complexity: (1) multicurrency - must track 3 symbols simultaneously with separate position state, (2) GUI panel logic not needed for backtesting - extract only OnTick auto-trading logic, (3) position reversal pattern (close then open opposite) must be atomic, (4) no SL/TP simplifies conversion, (5) manual panel trades can be ignored for backtesting - focus on AutoTrader mode, (6) lot adjustment is per-symbol manual input - default to 0.01 for backtest, (7) signal uses bar[0] vs bar[1] which is current incomplete bar so tick data preferred for accurate backtesting
